scope: Persistent and semi-persistent layers observed in the current workspace

layers.persistence: Persistent; 56 px desktop, 52 px at phone
layers.purpose: Identity, project context, lineage, RF context, result/status, and plan-level compute action.
duplicates: Result state and source recur in Results and map legend.
Draft state and local-save status appear as separate concepts without a clear grouping.
RF values are a peer series of text items.
layers.visualWeight: High; multiple adjacent outlined controls/statuses share one row.
layers.responsive: CSS hides fields at 1120/900/640 px; at 390 px the project name and product wordmark are hidden, run status is a dot, RF detail and local save disappear, and text overlaps.

layers.persistence: Persistent; 88 px desktop/tablet, 64 px bottom rail below 640 px
layers.purpose: Choose Plan, Simulate, Analyze, or Review.
actions: Select stage and its first available tool
duplicates: Stage is implicit in the tool-tab row's aria-label and tool grouping, but those have the separate sibling-tool job.
layers.visualWeight: Medium; narrow background rail with one selected stage.
layers.responsive: Vertical rail remains at 768 px; transforms to labeled bottom buttons on phone.

layers.persistence: Visible whenever drawer is open; 62 px desktop, 65 px phone
layers.purpose: Identify the single active tool or inspector.
duplicates: Tool title is repeated as selected sibling tab and may recur as an inner panel title.
layers.visualWeight: Medium; white header with bottom divider.
layers.responsive: Tool name and short subtitle truncate at constrained widths; close target grows to 44 px on phone.

layers.persistence: Always visible while a tool drawer is open; 51 px desktop, 59 px phone
layers.purpose: Fast tool switching, availability, and per-tool attention.
duplicates: Repeats current tool identity already in drawer header; stage membership is already represented by active rail.
layers.visualWeight: High when four tools are present; bordered active tab and row divider.
layers.responsive: Analyze/Review natural width is 513 px, versus 359 px drawer at 1440 and 390 px screen on phone. Horizontal scrolling is enabled but scrollbar hidden; end items are clipped.

layers.location: Tool drawer content; DisclosureSection controls and tool-specific sections
layers.persistence: Semi-persistent open/closed state within the current tool; some defaults open and Research/reference defaults closed
layers.purpose: Separate routine Planning controls, Advanced details, Research/reference, and tool-specific content.
duplicates: Research/reference and Advanced labels may recur inside child panels and badges.
layers.visualWeight: Medium/high; headers, divider/border, explanatory copy, and sometimes nested panels.
layers.responsive: Stacks in the drawer; controls and copy scroll within the fixed-height panel.

layers.scope: One selected tool, sometimes a nested result subview
layers.persistence: Visible while selected; scrollable; active tool state is app-owned
layers.purpose: Present controls, data, workflow state, and explicit computation.
actions: Tool-specific compute, selection, import/export, navigation, and disclosure actions
duplicates: Some tool titles repeat the drawer header; Results and Run history add their own view/list/detail hierarchy.
layers.visualWeight: Content-dependent; nested cards are common in Inventory, Results, diagnostics, and history.
layers.responsive: Drawer body remains scrollable; first tool control ranges from 129 to 592 px below drawer top depending on tool and required setup.

layers.persistence: Persistent overlay; actions enabled/available according to current data
layers.purpose: Control map selection, focus, RF layers, interference metric, and optional layers.
duplicates: Layer names and result interpretation recur in the map legend; status/context also appears in command bar.
layers.visualWeight: High in width and control count; one outlined floating container with grouped controls.
layers.responsive: 42 px high at desktop; wraps to 201 px at 390 px, where it overlaps the only unobscured map band.

layers.persistence: User-collapsible; expands conditionally by active layer
layers.purpose: Explain map symbols and active RF/result semantics.
duplicates: Result source is repeated in global result context and Results card; other legend values are unique scientific interpretation.
layers.visualWeight: High when several layers are active; one bordered floating panel with sections.
layers.responsive: Width is 180 px; constrained by map area and can sit behind/near the phone drawer.

layers.persistence: Transient; replaces tool drawer content while selection is inspected
layers.purpose: Show selected tower/building/path object details with map context retained.
duplicates: Cell identity can recur in RF context, Focus selector, and tool controls.
layers.visualWeight: Medium; map popup and a second drawer mode can be visible together.
layers.responsive: Popup and full-width tool sheet compete for limited phone map area.

layers.location: Leaflet zoom, map selection overlays, and temporary map prompts
layers.purpose: Direct map navigation and feedback for plan or selection state.
information: plan changed/result out of date/map readiness
duplicates: A map prompt may repeat the operation status shown in the command bar.
layers.visualWeight: Contextual and may overlap map geometry.
layers.responsive: Map prompt and toolbar shift around the bottom rail/sheet on phone.

layers.location: Command bar ResultContextBadge, Results result card, MapLegend Result source, and map prompt
layers.persistence: Conditional on current, stale, historical, unsupported, or unavailable result context
layers.purpose: Preserve lineage and prevent a result from being mistaken for current plan output.
duplicates: Freshness and run identity can be shown in three locations at once; result score/overlap are also in the global summary.
layers.responsive: Header badge/metric are clipped or hidden at narrower breakpoints; map legend is partly obscured by mobile sheet.

layers.location: Command-bar run/save statuses, .global-error-banner, map-plan-prompt, .undo-toast, local panel statuses
layers.scope: Global operation, persistence, validation, or transient undo
layers.persistence: State-dependent; errors/status may persist, toast is transient
layers.purpose: Report readiness, computation, local save, errors, plan changes, and undo.
duplicates: Run state and map prompt may both describe a stale/changed plan; save state and draft lineage can seem contradictory.
layers.visualWeight: Low to high depending on error; status appears alongside many command-bar items.
layers.responsive: Run status becomes dot-only and local save text disappears below 1120 px; map notices overlay content.
